blind.description: A weathered stone bollard comprising a slightly tapered cylindrical base, an intermediate rounded collar or ring, and a domed hemispherical top. The surface is solid, continuous, and textured with mottled beige, tan, and yellowish-lichen or moss patches, with slight surface cracks/weathering sculpted into the stone. The base sits flat directly on the ground without an added plinth or separate slab.
blind.from_above: A concentric circular shape with a textured domed top surrounded by the edge of the rim/base collar.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the figure (roughly 2 feet tall) and roughly the same width as the scale figure's torso (about 1 to 1.3 feet wide).
